title: FinScope
tagline: End-to-End AI-Powered Financial-Statement Analysis & RAG Ingestion Platform
summary: AI-powered financial-statement analysis platform turning unstructured PDF reports and SEC EDGAR 10-K/10-Q filings into structured, queryable data.
problem: Financial statements (10-K, 10-Q, annual reports) are notoriously dense, published across disparate PDF formats, and burdened by heterogeneous GAAP vs IFRS accounting terminologies. Analysts spend 70% of their time manually transcribing balance sheets and cash flow disclosures rather than evaluating company viability.
solution: Built a multi-engine ingestion pipeline using pdfplumber, PyMuPDF, and Tesseract OCR with semantic synonym mapping. Developed a 15+ ratio analytical engine, vector-based RAG search via ChromaDB and Sentence-Transformers, and ML distress forecasting to automate institutional-grade fundamental analysis in seconds.
keyFeatures: Multi-Engine PDF Ingestion: pdfplumber and PyMuPDF text extraction with Tesseract OCR fallback for scanned disclosures.
GAAP/IFRS Synonym Taxonomy: LLM-driven field normalization mapping disparate accounting line items to standardized schemas.
15+ Automated Financial Ratios: Instant computation of current, quick, debt-to-equity, ROIC, and asset turnover metrics.
Contextual RAG Chatbot: Vector search over multi-hundred page filings using ChromaDB embeddings for precision clause Q&A.
Distress/Risk ML Scoring: Scikit-learn predictive classifier benchmarking insolvency risk against historical peer company profiles.
Enterprise Security: Google OAuth 2.0 and JWT session authorization with Supabase PostgreSQL row-level security.
whatILearned: Key engineering insight: architecting deterministic fallback pipelines when LLM parsing encounters nested tabular balance sheets, and optimizing vector similarity thresholds for dense numerical footnotes.

screenshots.caption: Interactive 10-K financial statement analytics dashboard with normalized balance sheet metrics.
AI Financial Assistant panel answering granular debt trend and footnote disclosure queries.
Solvency and capital structure ratio engine benchmarking multi-period performance curves.

title: FloatChat
tagline: Conversational Ocean-Intelligence Platform with Hybrid NL2SQL & AST Validation
summary: Conversational ocean-intelligence platform turning natural-language queries into real-time insights from global ARGO float data.
problem: Global oceanographic data from hundreds of ARGO autonomous floats is siloed in complex netCDF files and multi-table relational databases. Marine researchers and climate scientists had to write intricate multi-join spatial queries or custom Python scripts just to inspect sea surface salinity and thermocline anomalies.
solution: Architected a hybrid NL2SQL + RAG engine with 18 zero-latency SQL templates, combined with an AST-based SQL validator that inspects parse trees to prevent SQL injection or destructive operations. Rendered 470+ floats on an interactive Leaflet 360-degree globe with voice input and dual persona workflows.
keyFeatures: AST-Based SQL Validator: Parses generated SQL into Abstract Syntax Trees, guaranteeing only safe SELECT operations execute against production schemas.
Hybrid NL2SQL + RAG: 18 high-speed parameterized query templates with ChromaDB vector lookup and fallback LLM generation.
Dual-Persona Interface: 'Explorer' mode for high-level geographic summaries, and 'Researcher' mode for granular profile depths and CTD sensor calibration.
Interactive 360° Leaflet Map: Real-time spatial clustering and path trajectories for 470+ active global ARGO floats.
Anomaly Detection: Rolling z-score statistical monitoring identifying regional thermocline deviations and salinity spikes.
Rigorous Quality: 49-test pytest test suite maintaining a 100% pass rate across query generation and security boundaries.
whatILearned: Key engineering insight: preventing generative hallucinations in spatial data queries through AST node whitelisting and client-side antimeridian projection handling.

screenshots.caption: Interactive global ocean map with real-time ARGO float trajectory markers and sensor locations.
Conversational NL2SQL input engine executing validated spatial queries against the float dataset.
Ocean temperature depth profile and salinity sensor telemetry monitoring thermoclines.

title: Mental Health System
tagline: Comprehensive Student & Institutional Wellbeing Platform with AI Triaging
summary: Full-stack mental health management platform for students, counselors and administrators.
problem: University student wellness centers face acute counseling bottlenecks, manual appointment queues, and lack real-time visibility into campus stress trends until academic performance severely drops.
solution: Built a 30+ module comprehensive management ecosystem featuring encrypted sentiment journaling, predictive stress indicators correlated with academic attendance, crisis alert routing, and role-based access for students, licensed counselors, and campus administrators.
keyFeatures: 30+ Modular Wellness Tools: Integrated mood tracking, symptom analysis, sleep logging, and sentiment-analyzed reflection journals.
AI Recommendation & Triaging: Correlates attendance markers with self-reported stress indicators to recommend proactive coping exercises.
Peer-Support & Conversational Assistant: Empathetic AI guidance bot offering immediate grounding techniques during acute anxiety episodes.
Crisis Alert Routing: Instant counselor notification triggered by critical sentiment keywords in journal entries.
Three-Tier RBAC: Strict privilege separation ensuring counselor medical notes remain confidential from student and administrator viewports.
Counselor Analytics: Aggregate weekly institutional wellbeing indices with exportable clinical compliance reports.
whatILearned: Key engineering insight: architecting privacy-first HIPAA/student data models in Supabase with row-level security and designing compassionate UI affordances.
